categoryInfo.title: Object removal
categoryInfo.description: Packs that remove what you select from a photo and rebuild the scene in its place, with no words, on the device, for Q-Dream Studio.

packs.name: Big-LaMa 512 · Object removal
packs.description: Removes what you select from a photo and rebuilds the scene in its place, with no words, on the device, large areas included: Big-LaMa (Samsung AI Center, WACV 2022), Fourier convolutions that see the whole picture at once. About 9 seconds a removal. Code and weights Apache-2.0; trained on Places2, a scene dataset licensed for non-commercial research.
packs.sourceOrg: Samsung AI Center (LaMa); ONNX conversion by Artiva, kept by Imaging for Good
